title: The Unexpected Tide
premise: Mara Eastwick ghostwrites the memoirs of her college rival, Celeste Vane, while hiding that she once loved—and lost—Celeste's brother, Julian. When a family reunion on Gull Island threatens to expose her as the family's forgotten failure, Mara hires a stranger, ferry mechanic Theo Marsh, to pose as her boyfriend. But Theo turns out to be the anonymous novelist whose career Mara secretly built with uncredited rewrites, and by dessert their fake romance has become dangerously real. As the memoir deadline collides with the last ferry of the season, Julian returns to reclaim both his sister's book and Mara's heart, forcing Theo to choose between the writing career that saved him from obscurity and the woman who finally sees him clearly. In the end, Mara claims her own name on the page and boards the last ferry not to flee, but to start over—with Theo at the rail beside her.
about_author: Zephyrine Blackwood is the pen name of a former lighthouse keeper's daughter who spent a decade writing other people's love stories before claiming one of her own. She lives off-season on a tidal island, where she collects ferry timetables and unfinished letters.

chapters.title: Ghost Ink
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. In her Boston apartment, Mara delivers another chapter of Celeste Vane's memoirs under a confidentiality clause that erases her name. A rejection letter for her own novel sits unopened. Emotional beat: quiet resentment and self-erasure, establishing what belonging costs her.

chapters.title: The Summons
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Her mother calls: the Eastwick reunion on Gull Island, three weeks, everyone expected—including Mara, whose last visit ended in scandal. Her agent simultaneously warns the Vane memoir is behind schedule. Emotional beat: dread doubling down; two worlds converging on one calendar.

chapters.title: A Stranger at the Dock
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Ferry mechanic Theo Marsh patches engines and writes novels no one reads under a pseudonym. He notices Mara studying the timetable like an escape route. Emotional beat: mutual recognition of two people hiding in plain sight.

chapters.title: Terms of Engagement
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Over bad chowder, Mara proposes a paid fake relationship for the reunion. Theo, needing rent money, negotiates rules: no real names in the story they'll tell, no real feelings. Emotional beat: wary contract, comic friction, first spark neither admits.

chapters.title: Crossing Over
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The ferry ride to Gull Island; Theo learns his passenger is 'the ghostwriter' only after they're underway. Mara rehearses her cover story. Emotional beat: point of no return, salt wind and small lies.

chapters.title: The Eastwick Table
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. First family dinner: her brother's perfect marriage, her mother's barbed compliments, her father's silence. Theo plays his role too well, defending her unprompted. Emotional beat: humiliation transmuted into unexpected warmth.

chapters.title: Celeste Calls
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Celeste video-calls demanding a rewrite that paints Julian heroically; Mara realizes the memoir will resurrect the past she buried. She lies about her location. Emotional beat: the two deceptions begin braiding together.

chapters.title: Low Tide Confessions
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Walking the exposed flats, Theo almost tells Mara he's the novelist she's been anonymously rescuing for years. Instead he asks about her abandoned manuscript. Emotional beat: intimacy deepening past the contract's borders.

chapters.title: Julian's Shadow
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Flashback woven through present: college-era love with Julian Vane, ended when she chose anonymity over ambition—or so she told herself. A letter arrives: Julian is coming to the island. Emotional beat: old wound reopened.

chapters.title: Storm Warning
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. The ferry schedule posts the season's final crossing; a storm system threatens to end service early. Theo realizes his window with Mara is physically finite. Emotional beat: urgency disguised as weather talk.

chapters.title: Rehearsal for Real
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Trapped indoors by rain, Mara and Theo improvise their 'how we met' story until it stops being fiction. A near-kiss interrupted by her mother. Emotional beat: the fake relationship tipping irreversibly real.

chapters.title: The Rival Arrives
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Julian steps off the supply boat, charming the whole reunion, and greets Mara like no time has passed. Theo watches, learning more than Mara knows. Emotional beat: jealousy sharpening into suspicion.

chapters.title: Manuscript Evidence
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Snooping for answers, Theo finds pages of the Vane memoir in Mara's bag—and recognizes his own stolen sentences, rewritten by her hand years ago. Emotional beat: betrayal and awe tangled together.

chapters.title: Confrontation at the Cliffs
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Theo accuses; Mara confesses the ghostwriting but not the deeper secret—that his pseudonym's success was built on her uncredited work. Julian interrupts, claiming Mara still belongs to their history. Emotional beat: midpoint rupture, all masks cracking.

chapters.title: What the Tide Takes
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Devastated, Mara drafts her resignation from the memoir and a confession letter to Theo, then loses both pages to the wind. Julian offers her a co-credit deal that would require lying to Theo forever. Emotional beat: rock bottom, the price of survival made explicit.

chapters.title: The Other Woman's Story
chapters.summary: Celeste's POV (interlude). Celeste reveals she always knew who her ghostwriter was—and hired Mara precisely because she once took everything from her. Emotional beat: rival reframed as mirror; the theme of identity turned inside out.

chapters.title: Last Ferry Notice
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. The storm accelerates; the final crossing moves up to tomorrow morning. Theo must choose: board with his finished manuscript and the career it promises, or stay for a woman who lied to him. Emotional beat: ticking clock made flesh.

chapters.title: Reading Aloud
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Night before departure: Theo finds Mara's lost confession pages caught in the dune grass. He reads her true feelings—and her admission that she gave him his career. Emotional beat: anger dissolving into grief, then tenderness.

chapters.title: The Reckoning Dinner
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Final reunion dinner: Mara publicly claims authorship of her own life, rejects Julian's deal, and tells her family the truth about every year she vanished. Emotional beat: climax of identity; belonging claimed, not granted.

chapters.title: Ferry at Dawn
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. At the dock, Theo holds out his hand—not a ticket, but his manuscript dedication page bearing her name. Julian watches from the crowd. They board together as the horn sounds. Emotional beat: climax resolved through choice, not rescue.

chapters.title: Bylines
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Weeks later: the memoir publishes with dual credit, Celeste's amends accepted, and Mara's own novel sold under her real name. Emotional beat: restoration; the past tense becomes present.

chapters.title: The Unexpected Tide
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Off-season on Gull Island, the two watch an unseasonal warm current bring early boats back. Theo proposes—not marriage, but co-authorship of whatever comes next. Emotional beat: belonging fully realized; the tide that was never expected becomes home.
